abstract: The multipath complex of the bidirected five-cycle has integral homotopy type of a wedge of one two-sphere and two three-spheres. An exhaustive acyclic partial matching with exactly four critical faces and two independent integral top cycles gives a direct attaching-map proof.
scientific_integrity: All finite combinatorial claims are reproduced by a standalone exhaustive checker with a separately stored explicit pair certificate; the topological conclusion additionally uses standard discrete-Morse and CW attaching-map theorems.
scientific_limitations: Exact five-vertex case only; no assertion for longer polygons, no equivariant homotopy classification, no independent audit. Residual risk of unlocated prior treatment is retained.
title: A two- and three-sphere wedge from the bidirected pentagon multipath complex
